articles.summary: LONDON, May 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals International, plc (Nasdaq: KNSA) today announced that management will participate in fireside chats at the following investor conferences in June: 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, June 3 at 8:45 a.m.
articles.title: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences
